dataset.title: A list of the terrestrial and marine biota from the Azores

stop_rules: stop if GBIF UUID, DOI, title, publisher or licence differs from the frozen metadata contract
stop if the Darwin Core Archive cannot be downloaded reproducibly; any transport fallback must be declared before archive parsing
stop if a later response-blind node rule does not resolve exactly the nine declared islands
stop if any later predeclared climate product or variable is nodata at a frozen node; do not snap, replace coordinates, change resolution, impute or drop nodes after the climate contract is frozen
do not parse species-island incidence or fit any predictive outcome before source bytes, node universe, climate table and world universe have each been frozen
